RestoreToTime 'must be specified if the UseLatestRestorableTime parameter is not provided' and must be before the latest restorable time; the page does not say whether this applies only to point-in-time restores (SourceDBClusterIdentifier), and the restorable time is external state, so it is not registered.
RestoreType copy-on-write cannot be used when the source cluster engine version is earlier than 1.11 (depends on the source cluster).

StorageEncrypted is 'Required: Conditional': when restoring, KmsKeyId must be specified if the source is unencrypted and StorageEncrypted is true, and StorageEncrypted must not be false if the source is encrypted (depends on the source snapshot or cluster).

PreferredBackupWindow must be at least 30 minutes and must not conflict with PreferredMaintenanceWindow; PreferredMaintenanceWindow must be at least 30 minutes; window arithmetic is not expressible with the operators. Partial implementation DOCDB_CLUSTER_WINDOWS: Checks explicit UTC backup/maintenance windows have at least 30 minutes and do not overlap, including day/week wraparound. Equal endpoints, unsupported formats and omitted service-selected schedules remain under review.
DBSubnetGroupName, SnapshotIdentifier and SourceDBClusterIdentifier must match existing resources (external state).

NetworkType (IPV4 | DUAL) and StorageType (standard | iopt1) value lists on the page are absent from the pinned schema; NetworkType must also be supported by the DB subnet group (depends on another resource). Partial implementation DOCDB_CLUSTER_MODES: Validate explicit NetworkType IPV4/DUAL and StorageType standard/iopt1 values. Subnet-group network support, omitted defaults and runtime compatibility remain held.
Name must not match the name of an existing DBClusterParameterGroup (external state).
Tags: the page says up to 10 tags can be assigned to an instance, but the pinned schema has no maxItems; confirm whether this is a current service limit before registering it.

PreferredMaintenanceWindow: minimum 30-minute window is not expressible with the declarative operators. Partial implementation DOCDB_INSTANCE_WINDOW: Checks explicit UTC weekly maintenance duration is at least 30 minutes. Equal endpoints, unsupported formats and unresolved schedules remain under review.
CertificateRotationRestart should be set only when clients do not use SSL/TLS (depends on client usage).

The subnets must be in at least two different Availability Zones; this depends on the subnet resources. Partial implementation DOCDB_SUBNET_AZ_SPREAD: Validate at least two distinct standard AZ names from uniquely linked same-scope subnets; explicit arrays with fewer than two entries fail this necessary condition. Unknown members, AZ IDs, VPC membership and oversized inputs remain held.

DBSubnetGroupName: the page allows letters, numbers, periods, underscores, spaces or hyphens, while the pinned schema pattern [a-zA-Z][0-9a-zA-Z-:._ ]* (unanchored) also allows ':'; the character set is left for manual review.

SourceIds must identify resources of the given SourceType (instance, security group, parameter group, snapshot); this depends on the referenced resources. Partial implementation DOCDB_EVENT_SOURCE_TYPES: Match explicit DocDB DBInstance and DBCluster links against SourceType. Unknown and external references remain reviewable. Parameter-group, security-group and snapshot identity evidence needs further source/model work; do not infer unrelated resource mappings.

SourceIds items 'can't end with a hyphen or contain two consecutive hyphens'; the pinned schema item pattern does not reject consecutive hyphens and per-item string checks are not expressible, so check manually. Partial implementation DOCDB_SOURCE_ID_HYPHENS: Checks literal SourceIds have neither trailing nor consecutive hyphens. Unknown IDs, other existing character constraints and actual source existence remain separate.
AdminUserPassword is 'Required: Conditional' but the page does not state the condition (presumably AuthType PLAIN_TEXT versus SECRET_ARN); confirm when it must be specified.

AdminUserPassword constraints (8 to 100 characters; no '/', '"' or '@') are not registered because the page does not say whether they also apply when AuthType is SECRET_ARN; confirm before registering a format rule.
AdminUserName cannot be a reserved word; the reserved-word list is not given on the page.

ShardCapacity: the page says allowed values are 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 and ShardCount: maximum is 32; the pinned schema has no enum or maximum for either property. Partial implementation DOCDBELASTIC_SHARD_BOUNDS: Validate explicit ShardCapacity 2/4/8/16/32/64 and ShardCount maximum 32. Unresolved inputs, an unverified lower bound and runtime quotas remain separate.

AuthType: the page lists PLAIN_TEXT or SECRET_ARN, but the pinned schema has no enum. Partial implementation DOCDBELASTIC_AUTH_TYPE: Validate explicit PLAIN_TEXT/SECRET_ARN AuthType. Conditional password requiredness and secret/password interpretation remain held.

PreferredMaintenanceWindow: minimum 30-minute window is not expressible with the declarative operators. Partial implementation DOCDBELASTIC_MAINTENANCE_DURATION: Checks explicit weekly maintenance window lasts at least thirty minutes, including week wrap. Equal endpoints, invalid and unresolved windows held.

DYNAMODB_MRSC_REGION_SET checks that explicit replicas and witnesses do not cross the documented US/EU/AP sets. Unknown/future Regions, table emptiness, creation/update sequencing and witness behavior under EVENTUAL remain under review.

DYNAMODB_REPLICA_KMS_REGION compares literal key/alias ARN regions with replica Regions. Customer-managed key presence across replicas and managed/customer key mixing still need SSE semantics clarification. Key existence, status and bare key IDs/aliases remain external checks.
SSESpecification.SSEType: the description says the only supported value is KMS, but the page's Allowed values list AES256 | KMS and the pinned schema has no enum; confirm whether AES256 is rejected.

Top-level ReadProvisionedThroughputSettings and ReadOnDemandThroughputSettings, and GlobalSecondaryIndexes[*].ReadProvisionedThroughputSettings / ReadOnDemandThroughputSettings, 'can only be applied for multi-account global tables'; the page does not say which property values identify a multi-account global table (for example GlobalTableSourceArn), so no rule was registered.

Replicas[*].ReadProvisionedThroughputSettings and Replicas[*].GlobalSecondaryIndexes[*].ReadProvisionedThroughputSettings are described as read capacity settings 'when the BillingMode is set to PROVISIONED'; the page does not state explicitly that they are rejected under PAY_PER_REQUEST.

KeySchema and AttributeDefinitions are optional in the pinned schema and on the page (Required: No); the page does not state when they are required (for example for a table that is not a multi-account replica with GlobalTableSourceArn).
GlobalSecondaryIndexes: up to 20 indexes (a service quota), and only one index may be created or deleted per stack operation (update-time); not registered.

VectorIndexes is documented on the page (it requires BillingMode PAY_PER_REQUEST and SearchSchema attributes must be in AttributeDefinitions) but is absent from the pinned schema; no rule was registered.
The StreamArn attribute can be used only when StreamSpecification is specified; this depends on Fn::GetAtt usage in other resources and is not registered.
Table/index key attributes, combined GSI/LSI names, and INCLUDE attribute totals are checked locally. Remaining GSI throughput, current quotas and external table state still require review.
InitializationGracePeriodSeconds: the page text says 'Valid values: 1 to 600' but the page and pinned schema list Minimum -1; confirm whether -1 or 0 is accepted before registering a lower bound.

The account limit of 50 application status checks and the requirement to associate the check with instances or tags (AssociateApplicationStatusCheck) before health checks start are outside the resource's property values.
S3BucketName: the bucket must exist and be accessible by the EC2 Capacity Manager service (bucket policy); this external state cannot be checked from the resource's properties.

Future-dated Capacity Reservation constraints (InstanceMatchCriteria must be targeted, OutPostArn and PlacementGroupArn not supported, at least 32 vCPUs, only C/M/R/I/T/G families, EndDate outside the commitment duration) cannot be evaluated because the schema exposes no writable start-date or future-dated indicator.
UnusedReservationBillingOwnerId: billing can be assigned only for Capacity Reservations shared through AWS RAM and the target account must accept; this depends on other resources and external state.

The pages do not state whether AvailabilityZone and AvailabilityZoneId are mutually exclusive or whether one of them is required; confirm before registering a rule. The CreateCapacityReservation API also marks both AZ fields optional without defining their combined requirement; checked 2026-10-03, so no exclusivity or required rule is inferred.

RemoveEndDate and NoRemoveEndDate describe adding or removing an end date on an existing fleet (update behaviour); whether they may be set at creation together with EndDate is not stated. CreateCapacityReservationFleet has no RemoveEndDate or NoRemoveEndDate parameters; this does not establish how the CloudFormation create handler treats them, so the creation restriction remains unconfirmed (2026-10-03).
When some InstanceTypeSpecifications use AvailabilityZone and others use AvailabilityZoneId, their equality needs the AZ name-to-ID mapping and remains unresolved.

AWS::EC2::CarrierGateway.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag property page and 5 schema descriptions; the only constraints stated are the tag key/value aws: prefix patterns and lengths, which the pinned schema already enforces.

open_questions: ClientCidrBlock is checked against linked target-network VPC and route CIDRs by EC2_CLIENT_VPN_CIDR_NONOVERLAP; external associations and unresolved CIDRs still need review.
ServerCertificateArn and ClientRootCertificateChainArn must be certificates provisioned in ACM and signed by a CA; this is external state.
TargetVpcSubnetId presence for a linked VPC-based Client VPN endpoint is checked by EC2_CLIENT_VPN_ROUTE_ENDPOINT_MODE; whether a non-local subnet is an associated target network still needs review.

EC2_CLIENT_VPN_ROUTE_DEPENDENCY checks explicit same-template target-network ordering, including local routes, when Template metadata and endpoint/subnet relations are supplied. External associations, unresolved membership and Transit Gateway-only target-network models are not determined by current input.
SubnetId or AvailabilityZone/AvailabilityZoneId presence is checked against the linked Client VPN endpoint mode by EC2_CLIENT_VPN_ASSOCIATION_ENDPOINT_MODE; unresolved endpoints still need review.
Linked VPC-based associations are checked for distinct Availability Zones and a common VPC by EC2_CLIENT_VPN_ASSOCIATION_NETWORK; external associations and unresolved subnet values still need review.
BgpAsn documents a default of 65000 while both BgpAsn and BgpAsnExtended say one of them must be specified; whether specifying both is rejected is not stated.

EC2_VPN_CUSTOMER_GATEWAY_ADDRESS_TYPE checks IpAddress against OutsideIpAddressType on explicitly linked VPN connections, including the PublicIpv4 default. External VPN connections and unresolved gateway references remain unverified.

Placement properties (Affinity, AvailabilityZone, HostId, HostResourceGroupArn, PartitionNumber, Tenancy) are documented as 'not supported for CreateFleet' although the schema accepts them in overrides; confirm whether they may be set, and whether the HostResourceGroupArn/Tenancy host condition applies.

Overrides AvailabilityZone/AvailabilityZoneId: the text says either 'must be specified in the request, but not both'; only 'not both' is registered because overrides commonly specify a subnet instead of an Availability Zone.
TargetCapacityUnitType is checked against design-known overrides and linked launch templates by EC2_FLEET_UNIT_TYPE_REQUIRES_ATTRIBUTES; external launch templates still need review.

EC2_EBS_SIZE_BY_TYPE and EC2_EBS_IOPS_BY_TYPE check documented per-volume-type ranges on explicit override block devices. The statement that KmsKeyId is supported only for RunInstances, RequestSpotFleet and RequestSpotInstances still requires confirmation for CreateFleet.

TargetCapacitySpecification: 'If the request type is maintain, you can specify a target capacity of 0'; whether a target capacity of 0 is rejected for request and instant fleets is not stated explicitly.

EC2_EIP_GATEWAY_DEPENDENCY resolves explicit primary Instance.NetworkInterfaces SubnetId or NetworkInterfaceId, plus a same-template LaunchTemplate version 1 primary NIC. Direct SubnetId, EIPAssociation and NatGateway routes remain supported. External NICs, missing/ambiguous primary indices, template versions other than the explicitly supplied initial version, default subnets and unresolved template membership require data not available in the design.
InstanceId is checked against design-known network interfaces and attachments by EC2_EIP_INSTANCE_SINGLE_INTERFACE; external attachments still need review.

AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway.rationale: The registered rules (EC2.EGRESSONLYINTERNETGATEWAY.TAG_KEY_AWS_PREFIX) duplicated cfn-lint, which reports the same violations on the CloudFormation export of the design (docs/cfn-lint-integration.md). They were removed in ruleset 2.0.0.

open_questions: EC2_ENCLAVE_CERTIFICATE_ROLE_LIMIT checks up to 16 distinct IAM roles per certificate within the design, conservatively handling unresolved identities. Existing associations outside the design remain unverified.
The associated role needs s3:GetObject on the returned bucket and kms:Decrypt on the returned KMS key; these permissions are external state.

DeliverLogsPermissionArn for kinesis-data-firehose: the page requires it when the delivery stream and the monitored resources are in different accounts, while the schema description says not to specify it for kinesis-data-firehose; the account relationship is external, so no rule is registered for firehose.
LogDestination ARN service prefix is checked; the destination resource existence, account access, ARN suffix, and log delivery permissions need external validation.
The gateway and route table VPCs are compared by EC2_GATEWAY_ROUTE_TABLE_SAME_VPC when their design references and gateway attachment resolve; external gateway attachments still need review.

EC2_HOST_INSTANCE_TYPE_FAMILY_EXCLUSIVE checks the API prohibition on specifying InstanceType and InstanceFamily together. Whether at least one is always required in CloudFormation remains undocumented.
Cidr/NetmaskLength presence is checked against a linked pool's AllocationDefaultNetmaskLength by EC2_IPAM_ALLOCATION_NETMASK_OR_CIDR; external pools still need review.
NetmaskLength range is checked against a linked pool's AddressFamily by EC2_IPAM_ALLOCATION_NETMASK_FAMILY; external pools still need review.

EC2_IPAM_PUBLIC_ADVERTISEMENT_SOURCE checks that PubliclyAdvertisable, including false, is supplied only for IPv6 BYOIP pools (API default source is byoip). The pinned schema requirement to always supply it for IPv6 conflicts with the optional API parameter and remains unresolved.

EC2_IPAM_POOL_SOURCE_LOCALE checks locale equality for linked source pools. Whether the locale is an IPAM operating Region and whether a Local Zone network border group is valid require IPAM and scope state.

EC2_IPAM_PUBLIC_SOURCE_SCOPE warns when PublicIpSource is set on an explicitly linked custom private IPAMScope. Default public/private scope attributes cannot be distinguished by current relations; free capacity and existing allocations in the parent pool require AWS state.
EC2_IPAM_POOL_CIDR_NETMASK_SOURCE checks linked pools. When the pool is external or its source is unresolved, the checker reports NEEDS_REVIEW.
The pages do not state whether static-cidr rules require StaticCidr, or whether ipam-resource-cidr rules require ResourceType and IpamScopeId.
ImageId presence across an instance and its explicitly linked launch template is checked by EC2_INSTANCE_LAUNCH_TEMPLATE_IMAGE; external template versions still need review.
SecurityGroups (names) can be used only in a default VPC; for a nondefault VPC security group IDs are required. Whether the target VPC is the default VPC is external state.

EC2_T3_HOST_CREDITS checks explicitly named t3.* instances with host tenancy as WARNING, including the documented unlimited default. T3a host support and broader instance capabilities still require capability data.

BlockDeviceMappings Ebs: 'You must specify either a snapshot ID or a volume size' is not registered because a mapping that overrides an AMI device takes its snapshot from the AMI; VolumeSize must also be at least the snapshot size, which is external.

EC2_EXISTING_NIC_LAUNCH_FLAGS prohibits AssociatePublicIpAddress=true and DeleteOnTermination=true with an existing NIC. Rejection versus ignoring Description, GroupSet and PrivateIpAddress with NetworkInterfaceId remains unconfirmed.

NetworkInterfaces AssociateCarrierIpAddress: the pinned schema says it is not currently supported by CloudFormation, while the page allows it only for subnets in a Wavelength Zone (external); confirm whether designs must omit it.
Volumes with explicit design references are checked against the instance AvailabilityZone by EC2_INSTANCE_VOLUME_SAME_AZ; physical volume IDs or unresolved instance zones still need review.
PrivateDnsNameOptions.HostnameType and MetadataOptions.HttpProtocolIpv6 depend on the subnet type (IPv4-only, IPv6-only or dual-stack) and on Nitro support, which are external.
HibernationOptions is valid only when the instance meets the hibernation prerequisites (instance type, AMI, root volume), which are external.

EC2_RETIRED_ACCELERATORS warns when ElasticGpuSpecifications or ElasticInferenceAccelerators are supplied, based on the service end-of-life notices. Actual CloudFormation rejection versus ignoring legacy properties remains unconfirmed.
PreserveClientIp: the page says the value for IpAddressType must be ipv4 to use it, but IpAddressType is absent from the pinned schema; confirm the endpoint IP address type before registering a rule.
Duplicate design endpoints in one linked VPC are checked by EC2_INSTANCE_CONNECT_ENDPOINT_VPC_UNIQUE; existing account endpoints and unresolved subnet references still need review.

AWS::EC2::InternetGateway.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag property page and 5 schema descriptions; the only settable property is Tags and no conditional wording exists.

AWS::EC2::IpPoolRouteTableAssociation.rationale: Checked the resource page and 3 schema descriptions; both settable properties are schema-required IDs and no conditional wording exists (the page introduction describes a route server association, a documentation slip rather than a condition).

open_questions: KeyType ed25519 is not supported for Windows instances; this depends on the AMI of the instances that use the key pair and is not checked.

LaunchTemplateData.InstanceRequirements is prohibited for explicitly linked AWS::EC2::Instance consumers by EC2_INSTANCE_LAUNCH_TEMPLATE_REQUIREMENTS; RunInstances and external consumers still need review.
LaunchTemplateData.ImageId omission is checked against explicitly linked AWS::EC2::Instance consumers by EC2_INSTANCE_LAUNCH_TEMPLATE_IMAGE; external consumers still need review.

EC2_TEMPLATE_ASG_PROFILE_EXCLUSIVE checks profile Arn/Name exclusivity for explicitly linked Auto Scaling consumers using the reviewed template version. External consumers and unresolved versions remain unverified.
LaunchTemplateData.InstanceMarketOptions.MarketType is Required: Conditional, but the page does not state the condition.

EC2_TEMPLATE_CPU_CAPABILITIES compares explicit template instance families with documented T-instance CPU credits and M6a/R6a/C6a AMD SEV-SNP support as WARNING. Launch-time overrides, new instance families and regional availability need capability data; unknown instance types remain reviewable.

EC2_TEMPLATE_PARTITION_PLACEMENT checks PartitionNumber against an explicitly linked placement group strategy. Shared-group ownership and the requirement for GroupId remain unverified; AvailabilityZoneId is absent from the pinned schema, preventing the documented AZ/AZ-ID exclusivity check.
BlockDeviceMappings Ebs.VolumeSize: 'You must specify either a snapshot ID or a volume size' is not registered because a mapping that overrides an AMI device takes its snapshot from the AMI.

NetworkInterfaces NetworkCardIndex: the primary network interface must use network card index 0; confirm whether DeviceIndex 0 identifies the primary interface on instance types with several network cards before registering a rule.
EC2_INSTANCE_TEMPLATE_PRIMARY_INTERFACE checks explicitly linked instance consumers of a launch template with secondary interfaces; external consumers and unresolvable versions still need review.
LaunchTemplateData.SecurityGroups (names) are for the default VPC only; for a nondefault VPC SecurityGroupIds are required (external state).

EC2_TEMPLATE_BATCH_USER_DATA_MIME checks base64-decoded MIME multipart user data for explicitly linked Batch consumers using the reviewed template version. External consumers and unresolved versions remain unverified.

AWS::EC2::LocalGatewayRoute.rationale: Checked the resource page and 6 schema descriptions; the only condition (exactly one target, LocalGatewayVirtualInterfaceGroupId or NetworkInterfaceId, with DestinationCidrBlock and LocalGatewayRouteTableId) is already enforced by the schema oneOf.

AWS::EC2::LocalGatewayRouteTable.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag property page and 8 schema descriptions; no conditional wording exists, and the tag aws: prefix and length limits are already enforced by the schema pattern and lengths.

AWS::EC2::LocalGatewayRouteTableVPCAssoc.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag property page and 6 schema descriptions; both settable IDs are schema-required, no conditional wording exists, and the tag aws: prefix is enforced by the schema pattern.

AWS::EC2::LocalGatewayRouteTableVirtualI.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag property page and 8 schema descriptions; both settable IDs are schema-required, no conditional wording exists, and the tag aws: prefix is enforced by the schema pattern.

AWS::EC2::LocalGatewayVirtualInterface.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag property page and 17 schema descriptions; the only conditional wording (tag keys and values cannot be prefixed with aws:, length limits) is already enforced by the schema pattern and lengths.

AWS::EC2::LocalGatewayVirtualInterfaceGr.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag property page and 13 schema descriptions; the only conditional wording (tag keys and values cannot be prefixed with aws:, length limits) is already enforced by the schema pattern and lengths.

open_questions: Regional NAT gateways (AvailabilityMode regional): the page does not state whether AllocationId, SubnetId or VpcId are required; the public AllocationId rule therefore excludes regional mode, and the default AvailabilityMode is not stated.
The network border group of each Elastic IP address must match that of the Availability Zone of the public NAT gateway; this is external.
AvailabilityZoneAddresses: AvailabilityZoneId is to be used instead of AvailabilityZone, but the page does not state that exactly one of them must be given.

AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl.rationale: Checked the resource page, the Tag property page and 6 schema descriptions; VpcId is schema-required and no conditional wording exists.

open_questions: RuleNumber and Egress duplicates among design-linked entries are checked by EC2_NETWORK_ACL_ENTRY_NUMBER_UNIQUE; external ACL entries and unresolved ACL references still need review.

AWS::EC2::NetworkInsightsAccessScope.rationale: Checked the resource page and its AccessScopePathRequest, PathStatementRequest, PacketHeaderStatementRequest, ResourceStatementRequest, ThroughResourcesStatementRequest and Tag property pages (the pinned schema has no descriptions); no conditional wording exists.

AWS::EC2::NetworkInsightsAccessScopeAnal.rationale: Checked the resource page and the Tag property page (the pinned schema has no descriptions); the only settable properties are the schema-required scope ID and Tags, and no conditional wording exists.

AWS::EC2::NetworkInsightsAnalysis.rationale: Checked the resource page and its property pages (the pinned schema has no descriptions); the 'must traverse' and 'must ignore' wording of FilterInArns and FilterOutArns describes analysis behaviour, and the remaining conditional text belongs to read-only attributes.

open_questions: Source and Destination must be ARNs when the resource is in another account; account ownership is external, so this is not checked.

AWS::EC2::NetworkInterfacePermission.rationale: Checked the resource page (3 property sections) and the pinned schema: all properties are required, Permission is limited by its allowed values, and no conditional wording applies.

AWS::EC2::NetworkPerformanceMetricSubscr.rationale: Checked the resource page (4 property sections) and 4 schema descriptions: all four properties are required and the page states no condition between them.

open_questions: SpreadLevel: the page says host can be used only with Outpost placement groups, which depends on Outposts configuration outside the resource properties.
SpreadLevel: the schema says it accepts host or rack 'when strategy is spread'; it is not stated whether SpreadLevel is rejected for other strategies.
MaxEntries: entries and the size of a prefix list can't be modified at the same time; this is an update-only restriction and is not checked at design time.

EC2_ROUTE_ENDPOINT_TARGET_TYPE checks that a design-linked VpcEndpointId is a GatewayLoadBalancer endpoint. External endpoint types, reachability, gateway attachments, and remaining target-specific reference/scope requirements still require review.

EC2_ROUTE_SERVER_PERSIST_DURATION compares known values with the CreateRouteServer API range 1-5 as WARNING. The pinned schema also permits 0, so strict CloudFormation rejection at zero remains unconfirmed.

AWS::EC2::RouteServerAssociation.rationale: Checked the resource page (2 property sections) and 2 schema descriptions: both properties are required identifiers and no conditional wording applies.

AWS::EC2::RouteServerPropagation.rationale: Checked the resource page (2 property sections) and 2 schema descriptions: both properties are required identifiers and no conditional wording applies.

AWS::EC2::RouteTable.rationale: Checked the resource page (2 property sections and the tag page) and 6 schema descriptions: VpcId is required by the schema and no conditional wording appears.

open_questions: VpcId (Required: Conditional): if omitted, the default VPC of the Region is used and creation fails when there is no default VPC; this depends on account state outside the design.

EC2 IpPermission API and the CloudFormation IpProtocol property explicitly allow omitted ICMPv6 type/code, while the CloudFormation introduction says both are required. Regression tests preserve omission without FAIL; the generic introduction discrepancy remains documented rather than adding a new required-port rule.
SecurityGroupIngress SourceSecurityGroupName: for security groups in a nondefault VPC the group ID must be used; whether the VPC is the default VPC is external state.
SecurityGroupIngress SourceSecurityGroupOwnerId is required when the source security group is owned by a different account; ownership is external to the design values.

EC2 IpPermission API and the CloudFormation IpProtocol property explicitly allow omitted ICMPv6 type/code. Omission is regression-tested without FAIL; the conflicting generic CloudFormation introduction is still unresolved.

EC2 IpPermission API and the CloudFormation IpProtocol property explicitly allow omitted ICMPv6 type/code. Omission is regression-tested without FAIL; the conflicting generic CloudFormation introduction is still unresolved.
GroupId / SourceSecurityGroupId: for security groups in a nondefault VPC the ID must be used instead of the name; whether the VPC is the default VPC is external state.
SourceSecurityGroupOwnerId is required when the source security group is owned by a different account than the stack; ownership is external to the design values.

AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupVpcAssociation.rationale: Checked the resource page (2 property sections) and 5 schema descriptions: both writable properties are required identifiers and the rest are read-only state.

AWS::EC2::SnapshotBlockPublicAccess.rationale: Checked the resource page (1 property section) and 2 schema descriptions: State is required and limited to its allowed values; the conditional wording only describes the behaviour of each mode.

open_questions: EC2_SPOT_FLEET_UNIT_TYPE_REQUIRES_ATTRIBUTES checks design overrides and linked launch templates; external templates and unresolvable versions still need review.
EC2_SPOT_FLEET_TEMPLATE_INTERFACE_ID checks linked launch templates for NetworkInterfaceId; external templates and unresolvable versions still need review.

SpotPlacement and LaunchTemplateOverrides: only the 'not both' part of 'Either AvailabilityZone or AvailabilityZoneId must be specified in the request, but not both' is registered; whether one of them is mandatory when Placement or an override is given is unclear.

InstanceNetworkInterfaceSpecification AssociatePublicIpAddress: 'You cannot specify more than one network interface in the request' is not registered because the scope of 'request' (per launch specification or per fleet) is unclear.
EC2_SPOT_FLEET_PRIMARY_PRIVATE_IP_UNIQUE and EC2_SPOT_FLEET_SECONDARY_IP_COUNT_EXCLUSIVE check nested launch specifications; unresolved arrays remain NEEDS_REVIEW.
TargetCapacity: the page allows a target capacity of 0 for request type maintain; whether 0 is rejected for type request is not stated explicitly.

Instance-type-dependent conditions (Network Load Balancer registration exclusions, M3 instance store mappings, EbsOptimized availability, unsupported performance-protection instance families) need external instance type data.
AWS::EC2::SpotFleet.rationale: EC2_EBS_SIZE_BY_TYPE and EC2_EBS_IOPS_BY_TYPE check the documented VolumeSize and Iops ranges for explicit launch-specification block devices; unresolved types and values remain NEEDS_REVIEW.

open_questions: InstanceId: the instance must run a Windows SQL Server license-included AMI (Windows Server 2019+ and SQL Server 2017+ Standard/Enterprise) with the Systems Manager agent running; this depends on the instance and AMI, not on this resource's values.
IPv6 IPAM allocation, IPv6-only mode, and remaining subnet conditions require review
EC2_SUBNET_DNS64_PUBLIC_NAT confirms a linked NAT gateway in a separate public subnet with an internet gateway route; absent or external routes remain NEEDS_REVIEW.
Ipv6CidrBlock is 'Required: Conditional' without an explained condition; it is presumably required unless Ipv6IpamPoolId (with Ipv6NetmaskLength) is used, but the page does not state this.

AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation.rationale: Checked the resource page (2 property sections) and 2 schema descriptions: both properties are required identifiers; the conditional wording only describes CloudFormation adoption and rollback behaviour.

AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation.rationale: The same-VPC condition is evaluated by the dedicated EC2_SUBNET_ROUTE_TABLE_SAME_VPC check when design references resolve; no additional declarative rule applies.

AWS::EC2::TrafficMirrorFilter.rationale: Checked the resource page (3 property sections and the tag page) and 5 schema descriptions: NetworkServices is already limited to amazon-dns by the schema enum and no other conditional wording appears.

open_questions: SourcePortRange / DestinationPortRange: the page says the port range 'applies to the TCP and UDP protocols' but does not say whether specifying it for other protocols is rejected or ignored.
SessionNumber ordering and reuse across multiple sessions on one source interface depend on other Traffic Mirror sessions and are not checked here.

The page says a target can be a network interface, a Network Load Balancer or a Gateway Load Balancer endpoint, but does not state that exactly one of NetworkInterfaceId, NetworkLoadBalancerArn and GatewayLoadBalancerEndpointId must be specified.
EncryptionSupport enable: creating the transit gateway with encryption support through CloudFormation needs the ec2:ModifyTransitGateway IAM permission, which is outside the resource properties.
EC2_TRANSIT_GATEWAY_SUBNET_AZ_UNIQUE checks linked SubnetIds; physical subnet IDs and unresolved Availability Zones still need review.

AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayConnect.rationale: The registered rules (EC2.TRANSITGATEWAYCONNECT.TAG_KEY_AWS_PREFIX) duplicated cfn-lint, which reports the same violations on the CloudFormation export of the design (docs/cfn-lint-integration.md). They were removed in ruleset 2.0.0.

AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayConnectPeer.rationale: The registered rules (EC2.TRANSITGATEWAYCONNECTPEER.TAG_KEY_AWS_PREFIX) duplicated cfn-lint, which reports the same violations on the CloudFormation export of the design (docs/cfn-lint-integration.md). They were removed in ruleset 2.0.0.

AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayMeteringPolicy.rationale: The registered rules (EC2.TRANSITGATEWAYMETERINGPOLICY.TAG_KEY_AWS_PREFIX) duplicated cfn-lint, which reports the same violations on the CloudFormation export of the design (docs/cfn-lint-integration.md). They were removed in ruleset 2.0.0.

ECS_CLUSTER_STORAGE_SINGLE_REGION checks MultiRegion on linked KMS keys, including the documented false default when omitted. Unresolved/external keys still require review; key permissions and ExecuteCommandLogConfiguration log-group/S3 existence remain external.

ECS_DAEMON_DEPENDENCY_TARGET checks declared target names, COMPLETE/SUCCESS nonessential targets and HEALTHY HealthCheck presence. Omitted Essential remains unresolved because the daemon-specific page does not document its default. Duplicate/unknown names, unresolved conditions, cycles and runtime agent/platform/health behavior are not certified.

ECS_DAEMON_MOUNT_VOLUME checks MountPoints.SourceVolume against declared Volumes.Name. Unknown volume names or unresolved container/volume arrays remain under review; mounted volume runtime availability is not checked.

ECS_DAEMON_AWSLOGS_OPTIONS checks required awslogs-region and awslogs-group for an explicit awslogs driver. SecretOptions substitution, unknown options, permissions, group existence and hosting-dependent stream-prefix requirements remain under review.

ECS.DAEMONTASKDEFINITION.LOG_DRIVER_VALUES enforces the eight documented allowed drivers independent of hosting. The smaller Fargate-only subset and actual agent driver registration still depend on capacity-provider/runtime information and remain under review.
ContainerDefinitions Secrets ValueFrom and RepositoryCredentials CredentialsParameter must be full ARNs when the secret or parameter is in a different Region; this depends on external state.

ContainerDefinitions SystemControls Value lists valid IPC and network namespace values (kernel.*, fs.mqueue.*, net.*) that appear to describe Namespace; it is unclear which property they constrain, so no rule is registered.
ContainerDefinitions LinuxParameters Tmpfs MountOptions lists valid values, but it is unclear whether options that take arguments (such as mode or uid) are accepted with values; not registered.

ECS_PRIMARY_EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER checks an explicitly linked same-scope Service declaration: EXTERNAL passes, ECS/CODE_DEPLOY fail. Missing/unknown controller types, conditional or unresolved references remain under review; deployed service state is not verified.

ECS_SERVICE_ROLE_NETWORK rejects explicit Role for a linked awsvpc task. ECS_SERVICE_TASK_NETWORK checks required/excluded NetworkConfiguration for explicit linked network modes. ECS_SERVICE_LINKED_ROLE_REQUIRED also rejects Role for proven service discovery, EXTERNAL controller inference accelerators or multiple distinct target groups. Literal ARN and linked logical-resource identities are not added together because they may be aliases; unresolved conditions remain under review.

CreateService explicitly documents ECS as the default when DeploymentController is omitted. ECS_SERVICE_DEFAULT_CONTROLLER_TASK now checks TaskDefinition presence for that case. Existing declarative rules cover explicit ECS/CODE_DEPLOY. An explicitly supplied empty or unresolved controller is not defaulted; unresolved task references, external task existence and existing-service update state remain under review.

AwsvpcConfiguration.AssignPublicIp says 'When the service deploymentController is ECS, the value must be DISABLED', which contradicts common Fargate usage with ENABLED under the ECS controller; not registered until AWS confirms the statement.

DeploymentCircuitBreaker 'can only be used for services using the rolling update (ECS) deployment type': the rule covers the CODE_DEPLOY and EXTERNAL controllers only; confirm whether it is also invalid for the ECS controller with Strategy BLUE_GREEN, LINEAR or CANARY.

ManagedEBSVolume per-volume-type Iops ranges (gp3 3,000-16,000, io1 100-64,000, io2 100-256,000), SizeInGiB ranges and the 1,000 MiB/s Throughput maximum are stated on the page but may lag current EBS limits; not registered. FilesystemType must match the snapshot's filesystem and SizeInGiB must be at least the snapshot size, which needs snapshot state.

ECS_SERVICE_REGISTRY_CONFIGURATION checks bridge/host container pairs and awsvpc SRV exclusive pair/Port requirements through explicit Cloud Map links. ECS_SERVICE_REGISTRY_CONTAINER_PORT checks the named task port. Unresolved network modes, DNS record types and external registries remain under review.

ECS_SERVICE_CONTAINER_PORT matches service container name/port to a linked task definition. ECS_SERVICE_AWSVPC_TARGET_TYPE rejects Classic Load Balancers and explicit non-ip target groups for awsvpc. CODE_DEPLOY target-pair association, unresolved targets, omitted TargetType and runtime ingress remain under review.

ECS_SERVICE_CONNECT_PORT_REFERENCE resolves PortName against the linked task definition; ECS_SERVICE_CONNECT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT rejects per-request timeout for TCP, including omitted AppProtocol. Unknown or duplicate port names and unresolved task definitions remain under review.

ECS_SERVICE_SPLUNK_OPTIONS checks splunk-token/splunk-url through Options or named SecretOptions. Secret contents/access remain external. The awslogs datetime/multiline wording conflict (cannot configure both vs ignored option) remains unresolved.

ECS_SERVICE_FARGATE_CAPACITY detects FARGATE/FARGATE_SPOT-only strategies when LaunchType is omitted and checks DAEMON, placement constraints and magnetic EBS restrictions. Mixed/custom/unresolved providers and cluster defaults are not inferred; other platform-version applicability remains under review.
EBSTagSpecification.PropagateTags: 'Tags can only propagate to a SERVICE specified in ServiceVolumeConfiguration' is unclear about which values are allowed; not registered.
ECS_SERVICE_COMBINED_CONSTRAINTS checks the service plus linked task-definition placement-constraint total against ten. Unlinked or unresolved task definitions still require review.

ECS_FARGATE_TASK_SIZE normalizes CPU units/vCPU and MiB/GB and checks the current Fargate table including 32 vCPU, Linux/Windows support and explicit FARGATE compatibility. ECS_EC2_TASK_CPU_RANGE checks the API range; 128-255 units remain under review due to a conflicting troubleshooting minimum. Unknown spellings, launch compatibility and Windows EC2 semantics remain under review. Large Fargate sizes retain a separate platform >=1.4.0 review.

ECS_TASK_CONTAINER_CPU_TOTAL checks Fargate CPU reservations and ECS_TASK_CONTAINER_MEMORY_TOTAL checks effective reservations (MemoryReservation before Memory). Proven totals above the task limit fail. Equality, unresolved allocations and Windows collective-limit semantics remain under review.

ContainerDefinitions/SystemControls: IPC namespace systemControls are not supported with IpcMode host and network namespace systemControls are not supported with NetworkMode host, but the SystemControl Namespace and Value descriptions do not clearly say which field carries the sysctl name, so these conditions are not encoded.

ECS_PROXY_REQUIRED_PROPERTIES checks explicit APPMESH property arrays for AppPorts, ProxyIngressPort, ProxyEgressPort, EgressIgnoredPorts, EgressIgnoredIPs and a nonempty IgnoredUID or IgnoredGID, based on CloudFormation/API plus the App Mesh guide. ECS_PROXY_IGNORED_UID compares numeric UID/User values for a uniquely named proxy container. ECS_PROXY_ESSENTIAL_CONTAINER checks its Essential setting, including the documented true default. ECS_PROXY_EGRESS_PORT_COUNT checks recognized comma-separated numeric ports against 15; exactly 15 without implicitly ignored port 22 remains unresolved. Omitted property arrays/type, duplicate/unknown keys, user/group names, compound User syntax, parameter value grammars, listener matching, runtime capabilities and service availability remain under review.

Platform and agent requirements outside the task definition are not encoded: Fargate platform versions for PidMode, SystemControls, Capabilities Add, EphemeralStorage, EnvironmentFiles, DependsOn, StartTimeout, StopTimeout and health checks; container agent, ecs-init and Docker Remote API versions; Swappiness is not supported on Amazon Linux 2023.
ContainerDefinitions/DependsOn is not supported when the task definition is used in a CodeDeploy blue/green deployment (AWS::CodeDeploy::DeploymentGroup); this depends on another resource.
NetworkMode awsvpc requires a NetworkConfiguration on the service or RunTask call; this depends on the AWS::ECS::Service or task launch, not on the task definition.
Windows-only restrictions are checked only when RuntimePlatform/OperatingSystemFamily is a WINDOWS_* value; confirm whether Windows task definitions in designs always declare RuntimePlatform.

RuntimePlatform/CpuArchitecture: ARM64 is described as available for Linux EC2, Managed Instances and Linux containers on Fargate; the page does not state an explicit prohibition for Windows, so no rule is registered.
Secrets/ValueFrom and RepositoryCredentials/CredentialsParameter: a full ARN is required when the secret or parameter is in a different Region; this needs the stack Region and is not encoded.

ResourceRequirements: the NeuronDevice resource type is only supported on Managed Instances; RequiresCompatibilities is optional and may list several launch types, so the scope of this restriction is not encoded.

Volumes/DockerVolumeConfiguration: Docker volumes are described as only supported with the EC2 launch type; whether this also excludes EXTERNAL and MANAGED_INSTANCES compatibilities is not stated, so only the Fargate exclusion is encoded.

ECS_TASKSET_REGISTRY_CONFIGURATION and ECS_TASKSET_REGISTRY_CONTAINER_PORT check explicit linked task modes, Cloud Map SRV records and task ports. Unresolved or external references still require review.

AssignPublicIp wording says DISABLED for an ECS deployment controller, but the same statement on the Service page conflicts with common Fargate usage. Do not register until the documentation conflict is resolved.

ECS_TASKSET_PLATFORM_CAPACITY checks PlatformVersion applicability when LaunchType is omitted: all built-in FARGATE/FARGATE_SPOT providers pass this prerequisite; all explicitly linked ASG-backed providers fail. Mixed, custom unlinked, Managed Instances, conditional and unknown providers remain under review. Platform version validity and runtime support are separate. ECS_TASKSET_EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER also checks the explicitly linked Service controller; omitted/unknown controllers and external service state remain unresolved.

ECS_TASKSET_VPC_MEMBERSHIP checks linked subnet/security-group VPC identities; ECS_TASKSET_CONTAINER_PORT checks the linked task port and ECS_TASKSET_AWSVPC_TARGET_TYPE checks explicit target types. External, dynamic, cross-scope and mixed logical/literal identities still require review; runtime ingress and target association remain external.
RootDirectory.CreationInfo is required if RootDirectory.Path does not already exist on the file system; whether the path exists is external state and must be confirmed.

FileSystemId: the page says only the ID format (fs-...) is accepted, but the pinned schema pattern also accepts a file system ARN; confirm whether an ARN value is rejected before registering a format rule.
ProvisionedThroughputInMibps: the upper limit (3414 MiBps) depends on the Region and can be raised through Support, so the maximum must be confirmed against the target Region and account quota.

PerformanceMode (generalPurpose | maxIO) and ThroughputMode (bursting | provisioned | elastic) list allowed values on the page, but the pinned schema has no enum for them; misspelled values are not caught by schema validation. Partial implementation EFS_FILESYSTEM_MODES: Validate explicit PerformanceMode generalPurpose/maxIO and ThroughputMode bursting/provisioned/elastic. Preserve existing conditional rules; omitted defaults, time restrictions and runtime quotas remain separate.

ReplicationConfiguration.Destinations: the text says that for One Zone file systems the replication configuration must specify AvailabilityZoneName and Region, but it does not state whether this refers to a One Zone source or a One Zone destination file system; confirm before registering a rule.
AvailabilityZoneName: One Zone file systems are not available in all Availability Zones; availability is regional external state.

IpAddress is described for IpAddressType IPV4_ONLY or DUAL_STACK and Ipv6Address for IPV6_ONLY or DUAL_STACK (default IPV4_ONLY), but the text does not explicitly forbid IpAddress with IPV6_ONLY or Ipv6Address with IPV4_ONLY; confirm before registering a rule.

IpAddressType must match the IP type of the subnet in SubnetId, and IpAddress/Ipv6Address must come from that subnet; this needs the AWS::EC2::Subnet values. Partial implementation EFS_MOUNT_IP_SUBNET: Checks explicit IPv4/IPv6 address membership in matching canonical CIDR of an explicitly linked subnet. IP type/native flags, address availability, noncanonical CIDR and unresolved references held.

SecurityGroups must belong to the same VPC as SubnetId, and for One Zone file systems SubnetId must be in the file system's Availability Zone; these need other resources' values. Partial implementation EFS_MOUNT_SECURITY_GROUP_VPC, EFS_MOUNT_ONE_ZONE_SUBNET: Compare explicitly linked security-group VPC identities to subnet VPC and explicit One Zone filesystem AZ to subnet AZ. Conditional, external, unknown or incomparable evidence remains NEEDS_REVIEW; omitted/default AZ and missing name-ID mapping are not guessed. Resolved implementation wave 132: Original question implemented and regression-tested against explicit design evidence. All original clauses covered: Compare every explicit security-group VPC with the mount subnet VPC, Compare explicit One Zone filesystem AvailabilityZoneName with subnet AvailabilityZone, Hold unknown/default placement, conditional references and incomparable VPC or AZ identities. Missing/unknown/conditional/external references retain NEEDS_REVIEW. PASS is limited to the stated VPC or One Zone placement condition; live existence, availability and general deployability are not claimed.
SecurityGroups: the maximum number depends on the account's VPC security group quota.

EKS_ACCESS_PRINCIPAL_DUPLICATE detects same-scope design collisions for explicit cluster and IAM principal identities. Existing AWS entries, unknown references and mixed logical/literal aliases remain under review.
ServiceAccountRoleArn: to specify an existing IAM role, an IAM OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider must already exist for the cluster; this is external state.
AddonName and AddonVersion must be an add-on and version available for the cluster's Kubernetes version; this depends on the cluster and on EKS add-on availability (external).

Configuration: the structure varies depending on the capability Type, but the text does not state explicitly that ArgoCd may be used only with Type ARGOCD or Ack only with Type ACK; confirm before registering a rule.

EKS_CAPABILITY_DECLARED_TRUST checks an explicitly linked same-scope IAM Role for unconditional capabilities.eks.amazonaws.com grants of both sts:AssumeRole and sts:TagSession (not eks.amazonaws.com). Exact literal actions may be split across statements; matching explicit denial or a known missing grant fails. Conditions, wildcard/case-variant actions, unsupported policy syntax, unresolved references and nonstandard partitions remain under review. PASS covers the declared trust only. Role/cluster account identity outside the strict link, external role existence, iam:PassRole, effective IAM permissions and Kubernetes RBAC remain unverified; KRO and default Argo CD do not universally require attached IAM policies.
EKS_CAPABILITY_NAME_DUPLICATE detects same-scope design name collisions within an explicitly identified cluster. Existing capabilities and unresolved references remain under review.

EKS_CERTIFICATE_AUTHORITY_COUNT rejects more than two explicitly identified design CAs for the same cluster. Existing signer/successor state, rotation sequencing and unresolved references remain external.

EKS_SERVICE_VPC_CIDR_OVERLAP compares explicit service IPv4 CIDR with linked VPC primary and IPv4 association CIDRs. Unresolved IPAM allocations, external ranges and unlinked or mixed-identity associations require review.

EKS_IPV6_CHINA_REGION rejects IPv6 in China Regions and EKS_IPV6_CLUSTER_VERSION checks an explicit Kubernetes version >=1.21. Dual-stack VPC/subnet assignment and VPC CNI >=1.10.1 still need cross-resource or runtime evidence.

EKS_REMOTE_PRIVATE_CIDR validates RFC1918 IPv4 ranges (/8..32), and EKS_REMOTE_SERVICE_CIDR checks overlap with explicit ServiceIpv4Cidr. VPC CIDRs/routes, networking and unknown service CIDRs still require evidence.
EKS_PUBLIC_CIDR_FAMILY rejects explicit IPv6 public access CIDRs for explicit ipv4 clusters. Undeclared IpFamily and historical IPv6 clusters created before October 2024 still require review.
ActiveCertificateAuthorityId must be the Id of an AWS::EKS::CertificateAuthority whose distribution status is COMPLETE; this is external state of another resource.

EKS_ENCRYPTION_KEY_REGION checks Region and EKS_ENCRYPTION_KEY_TYPE checks linked KeySpec/KeyUsage, including their documented defaults when absent. Key existence, permissions/state and external or unresolved references remain under review.

EKS_CLUSTER_NAME_DUPLICATE detects matching literal names on distinct same-scope Cluster declarations with known account/Region. Absence of a design collision does not prove AWS uniqueness. Unresolved names/scopes, cross-environment identity and underscores remain under review; CloudFormation prose excludes underscores while its pattern includes them.

EKS_FARGATE_PRIVATE_SUBNET detects proven direct Internet Gateway routes through a same-scope explicit subnet route-table association. Missing/main/external tables, unknown routes and mixed logical/literal aliases remain under review. EKS_FARGATE_IDP_ORDER checks dependency ordering for an explicitly identified common cluster/template; unknown membership or incomplete dependency graphs require review.
A Fargate profile can't be created while another Fargate profile in the same cluster is in the DELETING status; this is external state.

open_questions: The Member page does not state when NetworkConfiguration (create a new network) versus NetworkId and InvitationId (join an existing network) must be specified, or whether they are mutually exclusive; confirm against the CreateMember/CreateNetwork API before registering a rule.

The property pages list constraints that the pinned schema lacks (NetworkConfiguration Framework HYPERLEDGER_FABRIC | ETHEREUM, NetworkFabricConfiguration Edition STARTER | STANDARD, MemberConfiguration Name and NetworkConfiguration Name patterns, AdminUsername pattern, ThresholdPercentage 0-100, ProposalDurationInHours 1-168); they are only 'Allowed values'/range lines and are not registered as rules. Partial implementation MANAGEDBLOCKCHAIN_VOTING_BOUNDS: For explicit HYPERLEDGER_FABRIC, validate ThresholdPercentage 0..100 and ProposalDurationInHours 1..168 as integers. Unknown framework/values, defaults, missing name patterns, framework/edition enums and other leaf constraints remain held.

MemberId applies only to Hyperledger Fabric; whether the node's network is Hyperledger Fabric or Ethereum depends on the network identified by NetworkId (external state; for example n-ethereum-mainnet is an Ethereum public network), so 'MemberId only for Fabric networks' is not registered as a rule.
NodeConfiguration InstanceType and AvailabilityZone must be valid for the network's framework and Region; the allowed instance types are not listed on the page and depend on external state.

The page says that for each bridge you specify the type of bridge, but it does not state that exactly one of IngressGatewayBridge or EgressGatewayBridge is required; confirm before registering an exactly-one rule.

Each Sources item may contain FlowSource or NetworkSource; the pages do not state that exactly one is required, nor that ingress bridges must use network sources and egress bridges flow sources; confirm.
SourceFailoverConfig SourcePriority PrimarySource names 'the source you choose as the primary source'; the pages do not state that it must match a Sources item name.

Name must be unique among outputs in the bridge; this depends on the other outputs of the bridge identified by BridgeArn (cross-resource), so it is not registered. Partial implementation MEDIACONNECT_BRIDGEOUTPUT_DESIGN_DUPLICATE: Checks explicit design-local duplicate Name keys among distinct same-type resources in the same known scope and same unconditionally linked parent. No-conflict cases remain NEEDS_REVIEW; external uniqueness and other clauses of the original question remain unverified.

Name must be unique among sources in the bridge; this depends on the other sources of the bridge identified by BridgeArn (cross-resource), so it is not registered. Partial implementation MEDIACONNECT_BRIDGESOURCE_DESIGN_DUPLICATE: Checks explicit design-local duplicate Name keys among distinct same-type resources in the same known scope and same unconditionally linked parent. No-conflict cases remain NEEDS_REVIEW; external uniqueness and other clauses of the original question remain unverified.
FlowSource and NetworkSource are both optional; the pages do not state that exactly one must be specified; confirm before registering an exactly-one rule.

The pages do not state which Source settings are required together or mutually exclusive (EntitlementArn for entitled content, GatewayBridgeSource for a bridge source, or Protocol with ingest settings for a standard source); confirm before registering a source-kind rule.

A flow with a VPC source must first be created with a temporary standard source and then updated to use the VPC interface; whether Source.VpcInterfaceName may be set at creation is a deployment-sequence question and is not registered.

VpcInterfaces SubnetId must be in the Availability Zone of the flow; this depends on the subnet (external state). Partial implementation MEDIACONNECT_FLOW_SUBNET_AZ: Compare explicit ordinary AZ names of a flow and each uniquely linked same-account/Region subnet. Unknown/default placement, AZ IDs, local zones, unresolved/conditional links and deployed availability remain held.

The VpcInterface note states a maximum of three VPC interfaces per flow (in the context of NDI outputs) while AWS::MediaConnect::FlowVpcInterface says up to two; confirm the limit before registering a VpcInterfaces size rule.
The schema says to set FlowSize to LARGE to enable NDI sources or outputs; confirm whether LARGE (or LARGE_4X) is mandatory when Source.Protocol is ndi-speed-hq.
SourceIngestPort (read-only) says the port must be 2088 for Zixi sources; the Source IngestPort section does not repeat this, so no rule is registered for Source.IngestPort.

Source.Decryption SPEKE parameters (DeviceId, Region, ResourceId, Url, ConstantInitializationVector) are deprecated in the pinned schema although the page says they are required for SPEKE; confirm whether SPEKE decryption is still supported.

NdiConfig is also required when the flow has an NDI output, SourceFailoverConfig State limits the flow to one or two sources, and SourcePriority PrimarySource names a source; outputs and additional sources are separate AWS::MediaConnect::FlowOutput/FlowSource resources, so these checks are cross-resource. Partial implementation MEDIACONNECT_OUTPUT_NDI_ENABLED: The linked NDI output now checks its parent NdiConfig enabled condition. SourceFailoverConfig source-count constraints and SourcePriority source identities remain unimplemented; external flows and literal deployed IDs remain reviewable. Partial implementation MEDIACONNECT_DECLARED_SOURCE_COUNT, MEDIACONNECT_PRIMARY_SOURCE_IDENTITY, MEDIACONNECT_OUTPUT_NDI_ENABLED: Retain NDI enabled coverage; detect too many distinct declared source names for ENABLED/DISABLED failover and recognize declared primary source names. Source inventory completeness and external primary identities remain reviewable.

Encryption.Algorithm is required by the pinned schema, but the page says it must be left blank for SPEKE encryption, and the SPEKE parameters are deprecated in the schema; confirm whether KeyType speke is still usable for entitlements.

Name must be unique within the flow and each flow can have up to 50 entitlements; both depend on the other entitlements of the flow identified by FlowArn (cross-resource). Partial implementation MEDIACONNECT_FLOWENTITLEMENT_DESIGN_DUPLICATE: Checks explicit design-local duplicate Name keys among distinct same-type resources in the same known scope and same unconditionally linked parent. No-conflict cases remain NEEDS_REVIEW; external uniqueness and other clauses of the original question remain unverified. Same linked Flow entitlement Name duplicates only; entitlement count and external entitlements remain held.

Subscribers must be AWS account IDs; the pinned schema has no pattern and the rule engine cannot match every array item against a pattern, so the account ID format is not registered. Partial implementation MEDIACONNECT_SUBSCRIBER_ACCOUNTS: Validate each explicit subscriber account string as twelve ASCII digits, preserving leading zeros. Unknown/dynamic values, account existence, entitlement permissions and actual subscriber access remain held.
The Encryption section says the allowable encryption type is static-key, but the Encryption KeyType page and the pinned schema also allow srt-password; confirm before restricting KeyType.

Name must be unique within the flow and each flow can have up to 50 outputs; both depend on the other outputs of the flow identified by FlowArn (cross-resource). Partial implementation MEDIACONNECT_FLOWOUTPUT_DESIGN_DUPLICATE: Checks explicit design-local duplicate Name keys among distinct same-type resources in the same known scope and same unconditionally linked parent. No-conflict cases remain NEEDS_REVIEW; external uniqueness and other clauses of the original question remain unverified. Same linked Flow output Name duplicates only; output count and external outputs remain held.

EncodingParameters apply only to outputs on flows that have a CDI source, EncodingName must match the media stream type defined on the flow, and an ndi-speed-hq output requires the flow's NdiConfig with NdiState ENABLED; these depend on the AWS::MediaConnect::Flow resource (cross-resource). Partial implementation MEDIACONNECT_OUTPUT_NDI_ENABLED, MEDIACONNECT_OUTPUT_ENCODING_MEDIA_TYPE, MEDIACONNECT_OUTPUT_CDI_ENCODING_CONTEXT: Resolve explicit flow references. Require NdiState ENABLED for NDI outputs; match encoding to named media-stream type; prove CDI EncodingParameters applicability from a declared inline or additional CDI source. Exact video transport encoding, external source inventory, deployed flow ARN identities and conflicting CloudFormation CDI support prose remain unresolved. Partial implementation MEDIACONNECT_OUTPUT_CDI_ENCODING_CONTEXT: Correct CDI applicability to require a declared inline CDI source. Current FlowSource lists only transport-stream failover protocols and the guide excludes CDI failover, so unsupported additional CDI declarations no longer establish PASS. Other unresolved exact video transport and external identity clauses remain.

The intro lists the supported protocols as RIST, RTP, RTP-FEC, SRT-listener, SRT-caller, Zixi pull and Zixi push, which omits ndi-speed-hq allowed by the Protocol enum; only the explicit CDI/ST 2110 JPEG XS exclusion is registered.

Adding a source requires Failover to be enabled on the flow, the same protocol as the existing source, and FailoverMode FAILOVER for SRT caller/listener; these depend on the AWS::MediaConnect::Flow identified by FlowArn (cross-resource). Partial implementation MEDIACONNECT_ADDITIONAL_SOURCE_FAILOVER: Resolve the parent flow and verify enabled failover, matching known protocol and FAILOVER mode for SRT. Missing/unknown flags, external parent flows and conditional identity remain reviewable. Resolved implementation wave 166: Original question implemented and regression-tested against explicit design evidence. All original clauses covered: Resolve an explicit parent flow reference, Require enabled failover for additional source, Match supported source protocol with the declared existing source, Require FAILOVER rather than MERGE for SRT caller/listener. Missing/unknown/conditional/external references retain NEEDS_REVIEW. PASS is limited to the declared additional-source failover conditions; live existence, availability and general deployability are not claimed.

The Decryption section says the allowable encryption type is static-key, while KeyType allows speke and srt-password and the SPEKE parameters (and EntitlementArn) are deprecated in the pinned schema; confirm before restricting KeyType.
The pages do not state which source settings are required together or mutually exclusive (EntitlementArn, GatewayBridgeSource, or Protocol with ingest settings); confirm.

Name must be unique within the flow, including VPC interfaces nested in AWS::MediaConnect::Flow (cross-resource). Partial implementation MEDIACONNECT_FLOWVPCINTERFACE_DESIGN_DUPLICATE: Checks explicit design-local duplicate Name keys among distinct same-type resources in the same known scope and same unconditionally linked parent. No-conflict cases remain NEEDS_REVIEW; external uniqueness and other clauses of the original question remain unverified. Same linked Flow standalone VpcInterface Name duplicates only; embedded Flow interfaces and external interfaces remain held.

SubnetId: the subnets used across all VPC interfaces on the flow must be in the same Availability Zone as the flow (external and cross-resource). Partial implementation MEDIACONNECT_INTERFACE_FLOW_AZ: Resolve unique same-account/Region flow and subnet links and compare explicit ordinary AZ names. Unknown/default placement, AZ IDs, local zones, other interfaces, deployment sequence and service availability remain held.
A flow can have up to two VPC interfaces according to this page (three according to the Flow VpcInterface note); the count depends on other resources and the limit is inconsistent.

VPC interfaces for NDI outputs must be defined inside AWS::MediaConnect::Flow, not with this resource; whether the flow uses NDI outputs is cross-resource. Partial implementation MEDIACONNECT_NDI_INLINE_INTERFACE: Detect an explicit NDI output whose VpcInterfaceName selects a standalone interface on the same linked flow. External NDI outputs, unknown names and conditional links cannot establish absence and remain reviewable.
AvailabilityZone must be a valid Availability Zone for RegionName (or the current Region); this depends on external state.
Standard.Protocol is optional and the pages do not state that it must agree with the protocol key used in Standard.ProtocolConfiguration; confirm.

AWS::MediaConnect::RouterNetworkInterfac.rationale: Checked the resource page, 4 property pages (RouterNetworkInterfaceConfiguration, PublicRouterNetworkInterfaceConfiguration, PublicRouterNetworkInterfaceRule, VpcRouterNetworkInterfaceConfiguration) and 16 pinned schema descriptions. Standard.Protocol is optional and the pages do not state that it must agree with the protocol key used in Standard.ProtocolConfiguration; confirm.

HopDestinations Queue 'cannot be the original queue to which the job is submitted'; the submission queue is the template Queue unless a job overrides it, and the rule engine cannot compare two strings for inequality, so check manually that no HopDestinations Queue equals Queue.
SettingsJson must conform to AWS Elemental MediaConvert job validation (the CreateJobTemplate Settings model); the pinned schema types it as a plain object, so its content is not checked by any rule.

AccelerationSettings Mode has no allowed values on the page or in the pinned schema; confirm the valid values (for example DISABLED, ENABLED, PREFERRED) against the MediaConvert API. Partial implementation MEDIACONVERT_ACCELERATION_MODE: Validate explicit acceleration mode against current API DISABLED, ENABLED and PREFERRED values. Unknown/default modes, media compatibility, job execution and account quotas remain held.
SettingsJson must conform to AWS Elemental MediaConvert job validation (the CreatePreset Settings model); the pinned schema types it as a plain object, so its content is not checked by any rule.

ConcurrentJobs is constrained by the service quotas 'Maximum concurrent jobs, per on-demand queue' and 'Maximum concurrent jobs, per account' (account state, external); confirm the value against the account quotas.

Vpc.SubnetIds: for a STANDARD channel the subnets must be mapped to two unique Availability Zones; checking this needs the subnets' Availability Zones (external). Partial implementation MEDIALIVE_CHANNEL_SUBNET_AZS: Checks two explicit unconditionally linked same-scope Subnet resources have distinct known AZ names for explicit STANDARD channel. VideoDescription Width/Height and VideoPositionRectangle X/Y/Width/Height must be even numbers, and Border must be an even integer 0-100 with Width and Height each greater than twice Border; parity and this arithmetic cannot be expressed with the available operators. Partial implementation MEDIALIVE_VIDEO_EVEN: Checks explicit integer Width/Height and CropRectangle/OutputPositionRectangle Width/Height/X/Y parity. Unknown values and source-derived dimensions remain under review. Partial implementation MEDIALIVE_VIDEO_BORDER: Checks explicit Border is even in 0..100 and explicit Width/Height each exceed twice Border. Source-derived dimensions, unknown values and output-position compatibility remain separate.
H265Settings.TreeblockSize must be 32x32 for tiled encoding, but the page does not give the enumeration literal (the MediaLive API value is presumably TREE_SIZE_32X32); confirm before registering.

H265Settings GopBReference DISABLED, SubgopLength FIXED and GopNumBFrames 2 are also required when the resolution is greater than 1080p; the resolution may come from the source when VideoDescription Width/Height are blank, so only the tiled case is registered. Partial implementation MEDIALIVE_HIGH_RES_H265: Checks specified H265 GOP values when explicit Width >=1920 and Height >1080. Source-derived/omitted dimensions and other interpretations of greater than 1080p held.
H264Settings.EntropyEncoding CABAC 'must be in Main or High profile': confirm which Profile values (HIGH_10BIT, HIGH_422, HIGH_422_10BIT, MAIN) count as Main or High before registering.

H264Settings.QualityLevel must be ENHANCED_QUALITY and H265Settings.RateControlMode MULTIPLEX is required only when the channel is delivered to a MediaLive multiplex; confirm whether Destinations[].MultiplexSettings is a sufficient single-resource indicator.

M2tsSettings.SegmentationTime 'is required unless markers is set to None_' (UDP, SRT, MediaConnect Router and Archive containers): confirm that 'markers' means SegmentationMarkers and that the literal is NONE before registering.
HlsGroupSettings.TsFileMode SINGLEFILE 'Applies only if the Mode field is VOD': confirm whether SINGLEFILE with Mode LIVE is rejected or ignored.

Numeric ranges stated only in descriptions (FecOutputSettings ColumnDepth 4-20 and RowLength 1-20, M2ts PatInterval/PmtInterval 0 or 10-1000, M2ts/M3u8 PID fields 32-8182 in decimal or hex lists, AncillarySourceSettings SourceAncillaryChannelNumber 1-4, CaptionLanguageMapping CaptionChannel maximum 4) are not in the pinned schema; decide whether to register them. Partial implementation MEDIALIVE_FEC_COLUMN_DEPTH: Validate each explicit UDP FEC ColumnDepth integer in 4..20. Unknown/default depth, row-mode conditions, other numeric bounds and PID grammar remain unimplemented.

CaptionRectangle: LeftOffset + Width and TopOffset + Height must each add up to 100 or less; sums are not supported by the operators. Partial implementation MEDIALIVE_CAPTION_RECTANGLE: Checks offset plus size at most 100 when a uniquely named caption selector is explicitly used by TTML/EBU-TT-D output. Ambiguous/unknown selector names, other output formats and unresolved dimensions remain under review.

Caption selector names must be unique across all input attachments of the channel; the registered rule only checks duplicates within one attachment. Partial implementation MEDIALIVE_CHANNEL_CAPTION_NAMES: Checks caption selector Name uniqueness across every channel InputAttachment, with unknown names/collections held.

H264Settings/H265Settings.Bitrate must be unique (rounded down to a multiple of 1000) across the outputs of a Microsoft Smooth output group, and MediaPackageV2DestinationSettings HlsAutoSelect/HlsDefault (at most one YES, not all NO) and OutputUsage (all or none of the video outputs in a group) are group-wide constraints that need cross-referencing outputs and video descriptions. QVBR, omitted modes, unknown/ambiguous descriptions and MediaPackageV2 group flags held.
MediaPackageOutputDestinationSettings.ChannelId and MultiplexProgramChannelDestinationSettings.MultiplexId must be in the same Region as the channel (external).

Output settings reference descriptions and destinations by name (VideoDescriptionName, AudioDescriptionNames, CaptionDescriptionNames, Destination.DestinationRefId, CaptionSelectorName, MediaConnectRouterOutputSettings Destination must reference an OutputDestination with MediaConnectRouterSettings); cross-reference integrity is not registered.

Documented lengths and bounds for Name, Description, WindowId, TaskArn, Priority, Targets and nested Values/Key length, RunCommand, Lambda ClientContext/Qualifier, StepFunctions, MaxConcurrency/MaxErrors, CloudWatchOutputConfig, LoggingInfo and document versions are implemented. SSM_TARGET_KEY_CHARACTERS validates the Unicode target Key character classes. Lambda Payload 4096 needs clarification on encoded versus decoded length.

NotificationEvents: the page says the events 'include the following: All (events), InProgress, Success, TimedOut, Cancelled, Failed'; whether the list is exhaustive is not stated, so no items_in rule was registered.

SSM_PARAMETER_ALLOWED_PATTERN checks explicit String values against supported regular expressions with a matching time limit. StringList semantics, unsupported pattern syntax and unresolved values still require review.

SSM_PARAMETER_ARN_LENGTH checks explicit names against the ARN-inclusive 1011-character limit in known public partitions. Description and AllowedPattern maximum lengths are implemented. Unknown scope/partition still needs review. SSM_PARAMETER_HIERARCHY_DEPTH checks the 15-level maximum for recognized literal path names; reserved prefixes and unresolved spellings remain separate.

SSM_PARAMETER_POLICY_ARRAY validates JSON-array shape and ten-policy maximum. SSM_POLICY_TYPE checks the three supported policy types; SSM_POLICY_EXPIRATION_UNIQUE rejects multiple Expiration declarations. SSM_POLICY_DOCUMENTED_SHAPE recognizes the documented Version 1.0/Attributes examples without rejecting unproven alternative versions or missing/extra attributes. Timestamp validity, duration bounds, other compatibility and runtime event timing remain under review. Empty [] and documented removal [{}] do not imply an effective policy. Duplicate JSON object keys and dynamic JSON remain unresolved. SSM_POLICY_ADVANCED_TIER rejects explicit Standard with a recognized policy and accepts Advanced/Intelligent-Tiering for this prerequisite; omitted account defaults remain unknown.

Linux-only / Windows-only properties: Sources, ApprovedPatchesEnableNonSecurity and Rule EnableNonSecurity apply to Linux managed nodes only, but the WARNING rules only treat WINDOWS (and the default) as non-Linux; whether MACOS baselines accept them is not stated.

SSM_PATCH_FILTER_OS_PROPERTY checks the six property keys in the documented OS matrix plus Windows PATCH_SET, including the documented WINDOWS default. Other valid API keys such as ARCH/NAME and OS variants absent from that matrix remain under review, not rejected. SSM_PATCH_FILTER_VALUE_BOUNDS checks at most 20 values and 64 characters per known value; empty forms remain unresolved due to the flattened CloudFormation bounds. Dynamic product/classification/severity catalogs and PatchSource.Products remain external. SSM_PATCH_LIST_WILDCARDS checks macOS asterisk prohibition and the single-asterisk format for Amazon Linux 2/2023, Oracle Linux, RHEL and SUSE. Other wildcard syntax, unsupported OS variants and full package-name/ID grammar remain under review.
DefaultBaseline: the schema description 'Only registering to default patch baseline is allowed.' does not state a decidable condition; no rule was registered.
The page requires a value for either ApproveAfterDays or ApproveUntilDate but does not state whether specifying both is rejected, so the rule only requires at least one.

SyncType: SyncToDestination synchronizes to an S3 bucket and SyncFromSource synchronizes from AWS Organizations or multiple Regions, but the page does not state which properties (S3Destination or top-level BucketName/BucketRegion/SyncFormat, SyncSource) are required for each type or the default type; the intro defers to the Examples section. SSM_RESOURCE_DATA_SYNC_KMS_REGION compares literal key ARN Regions with BucketRegion for root and S3Destination properties. Unresolved key identities or bucket Regions still require review.
